purpose: Determine whether an exact raw-token local branch recovers within-block causality after compression/sparsity without conflating window, placement, normalization, or parent changes.

evidence_basis.supported: compressed causal blocks need a small uncompressed local path for unfinished-block detail
evidence_basis.not_transferred: 128-token window, branch fusion, quality, or runtime benefit

evidence_basis.supported: raw local, compressed global, and selected fine branches serve distinct roles and require joint normalization/gating to be explicit
evidence_basis.not_transferred: 512-token window, three-way learned gate, and kernel speed

evidence_basis.supported: current local block and selected historical blocks require causal handling and mathematically consistent softmax normalization
evidence_basis.not_transferred: block 512, top-3 routing, or prefill-only evaluation

evidence_basis.supported: Speck's earlier sliding FlexAttention path can be slower than dense attention at modest length, so a local branch needs realized kernel evidence
evidence_basis.not_transferred: one historical kernel shape as a permanent rejection of SWA

ordered_prerequisites: select the recurrent backbone and exact-cache representation
select and qualify dense HCA and precise CSA parents
freeze the causal identities and compatible key/value dimensions of compressed, selected, and raw entries
qualify a production-shaped local attention kernel for every window and execution mode
freeze local-specific quality probes, parameter matching, and analysis before outputs

fixed_parent.recurrent_path: selected KDA backbone including its internal short convolution
fixed_parent.precise_global_path: selected CSA compression, block, budget, and selector
fixed_parent.position: NoPE unless the parent selection explicitly changes it
fixed_parent.rule: no HCA, CSA, KDA, cache, placement, or residual parameter changes within the raw-local isolation

first_formulation.placement: one local ring at each of the same five global integration slots; do not add attention to the fifteen KDA-only layers
first_formulation.queries: share the precise CSA query representation within a slot
first_formulation.keys_values: retain exact raw K/V for the most recent W causal tokens using the selected cache representation
first_formulation.normalization: combine raw-local and selected-precise logits in one causal softmax over their deduplicated union
first_formulation.duplicate_rule: a raw token represented by both the local ring and a selected precise unit appears once at the highest-resolution raw identity
first_formulation.coarse_hca: remains a separately measured branch; its fusion rule is fixed by the selected parent and cannot change here
first_formulation.reason: a shared query and single precise/local softmax add no separate output gate and avoid confounding window utility with independently normalized branch scale
alternatives_not_authorized: parallel local attention with an unscaled output sum
local attention at every KDA layer

causal_and_state_semantics_required.window: retain exactly min(history, W) most recent causal raw-token identities
causal_and_state_semantics_required.current_query: a query may attend to itself and earlier raw tokens, never a later token
causal_and_state_semantics_required.chunking: full prefill, arbitrary prefill chunks, and one-token decode yield the same retained ring and output within frozen tolerances
causal_and_state_semantics_required.deduplication: raw/CSA overlap is deterministic before softmax and preserves one source identity
causal_and_state_semantics_required.prefix_reuse: local ring identity and write position are retained or deterministically reconstructed on a prefix hit
causal_and_state_semantics_required.eviction_resume: ring chronology, position, dtype, and quantization scales survive eviction, serialization, and resume
causal_and_state_semantics_required.unfinished_compression: raw local coverage does not authorize partial HCA/CSA summaries to violate their own causal emission rules
causal_and_state_semantics_required.state_accounting: report local raw K/V, scales, ring metadata, HCA, CSA, and KDA state separately

conditional_window_grid.reason: the frozen powers-of-two grid brackets the KDA convolution scale and the published local-window regimes without importing a preferred window
conditional_window_grid.selection: choose the smallest window that passes every language and local-specific floor and lies on the measured state/decode frontier
conditional_window_grid.discovery: all windows remain visible; selection uses mechanism-scale data and has no promotion authority
conditional_window_grid.confirmation: freeze one selected window before independent paired finalist cells

local_specific_endpoints: within-block order and exact-copy accuracy stratified by distance
boundary-straddling retrieval where evidence and query occupy adjacent compression blocks
unfinished-block retrieval before HCA/CSA summary emission
structured retrieval specificity under recent distractors
symbolic composition with one local and one distant edge
original aggregate and every-source language-loss non-inferiority

systems_and_accounting.analytic_state: five times W times the selected per-token exact-cache bytes plus ring metadata and scales
systems_and_accounting.compute: local score/value work, raw K/V projection or reuse, deduplication, union-softmax, dispatch, and tail handling
systems_and_accounting.minimum_state_reduction_claim: none relative to the no-local parent; local state is an explicit cost
systems_and_accounting.rule: retain a local branch only if its quality recovery justifies its added state and it does not erase the parent system's primary benefit

decision.next_action: after all parents qualify, implement reference union/deduplication/state semantics and run correctness only
